data.body:
RP-06 scope addition researched against current origin/main `5833794fe9`: add `review-plan --retry` as a true cross-invocation resume operation, eligible only when the literal latest completed review is journaled as `INDETERMINATE` and has retryable missing calls. Full note: `.joe-janitor/rp06-review-plan-retry-research.md` (ignored local archive).

Current seams cannot safely support it: `--force` intentionally runs a full review; REVIEW_RESULT v1/v2 has no digest-complete per-call journal; current Pass-1 cache keys omit prompt/routing/posture/output-contract/code/workflow/dependency inputs and can poison a failure as successful `[]`; aggregate verify/coach inputs change when a missing finder later succeeds. Legacy sidecars/checkpoints must never be retry authority.

Proposed RP-06 mechanics: a versioned retry lineage records every planned call, dependencies, exact input/output digests, typed status, usage/failure, snapshots/policy, cumulative spend, and verdict. Reuse only content-identical succeeded/resumed outputs (including successful clean and blocking results); failed/cancelled/shed/skipped never become success. Retry only missing discovery and new/unverified/uncoached findings; rerun deterministic assembly. Refuse with zero calls on stale/corrupt/legacy/missing journal, changed ref/source/material/code/criteria/prompts/contracts/model/topology, non-INDETERMINATE latest verdict, or no retryable gap. `--retry` is mutually exclusive with `--force`, `--status`, and `--check`; `--no-sign` remains compatible. A preflight/provider outage may qualify with all calls missing; config/claimability/cancellation-only indeterminacy does not.

Maintained prior art: Nextflow `-resume` requires a matching comprehensive task hash plus intact successful outputs; Argo `retry` reruns failed steps in the same Workflow and needs explicit `--restart-successful` to replay successes; GitHub Actions pins reruns to original SHA/ref and caps a lineage at 50; pytest `--lf` deselects prior successes and makes missing-cache fallback explicit. This supports pinned lineage + no silent full fallback.

One maintainer decision remains: recommend cumulative cost accounting across the lineage. Resetting the authored USD ceiling per click would bypass it. Under the recommendation, exhausted budget refuses before calls until an explicit monotonic cap raise; raising only the cap preserves content-identical successful outputs.
